about: Check catalog. scripts/verdict.py reads it. A check is needed if 'always' is true, or the confirmed kind is in 'kinds', or a changed file has a category in 'categories' (prepare.py), or a changed file matches a glob in 'paths' ('**/' also matches the repository root). A kind fits only if prepare.py's auto kind is in its 'auto' list and no changed file has a category in its 'forbid' list. 'impact' is set here, not by the plan: block = Request changes on fail; decide = Decide on fail (only what a maintainer must choose); security = Security report on fail; hold = Hold on fail; followup = the maintainer follows up after the merge (Approve names it). A needed check that the plan skips needs a skip reason with a passing evidence record 'skip:<id>' that shows the reason.

bugfix.q1: Users have the problem (release and main reproduce it), and this PR solves it

feature.q1: The PR does what it promises; a new option, default, schema, or dependency needs a decision

no-output-change.q1: Outputs stay the same, and the changed lines ran; for performance, a timing case

dependency.q1: Builds and tests stay the same; artifact contents and licenses are right

test.q1: The tests check expected results, and no existing test is weakened

docs.q1: Earlier decisions; each command, option, and number agrees with its source

tooling.q1: The scripts or workflows do what they say; a second maintainer reads them before an approval

mixed.q1: Split by purpose; each purpose has its own cases. Q1-solves and Q3-tests are needed: skip them with a reason if no purpose is a fix or a feature
